meta.question: get in at the ground (spectrum, not a bag), reconstruct, ablate, and ask Einstein/Tesla/Feynman how to improve DA

ground.name: space
ground.statement: a space X (manifold, group, domain, graph)
ground.why: Without X there is no operator and no mode.
ground.need: you pick X; it is not an output

ground.name: operator
ground.statement: a self-adjoint operator D on functions / forms / spinors on X
ground.why: Laplacian, Dirac, Hodge Laplacian, Casimir. Spectrum-of-what starts here.
ground.need: you pick D; eigenvalues do not invent D

ground.name: spectrum_and_modes
ground.why: This is the harmonic universe as mathematics. Consequence of (X, D), not a replacement for them.

ground.name: representations
ground.statement: how modes transform and couple (Peter–Weyl, Wigner, Clebsch)
ground.why: Compact-group harmonics. Still not a coupling constant.
ground.need: you pick G and the reps

ground.name: action
ground.statement: a principle that writes an action from those fields
ground.why: Gauge principle, equivalence principle, dim-4. These are choices. They are how you climb.
ground.need: must be added; not read off {λ_n}

ground.name: numbers
ground.statement: the measured couplings (g_s, g, g', G, Λ, Yukawas)
ground.why: Still a bag. A spectrum is not yet those numbers. That is the destination, not a pass.
ground.need: public theorem or F; neither is on the desk

reconstruct.name: sphere_laplacian
reconstruct.why: The angular dictionary Track B already uses.

reconstruct.name: torus_fourier
reconstruct.statement: X = T^n or R^n, D = Δ → characters e^{iξ·x}
reconstruct.why: Galerkin / Fourier on A. Abelian Peter–Weyl.

reconstruct.name: compact_group
reconstruct.statement: X = G compact, D = Casimir → Peter–Weyl / Wigner D
reconstruct.why: Representation harmonics. You already chose G.

reconstruct.name: hodge
reconstruct.statement: Hodge Laplacian on k-forms → Betti numbers = dim ker Δ
reconstruct.why: Topology as a kernel. Different bundle from Δu=0 on functions.

reconstruct.name: to_sm_couplings
reconstruct.statement: (X, D, σ, Rep) → (g_s, g, g', v, Yukawas)
reconstruct.why: You must still add G, the reps, and the numbers. Harmonic math does not spit them.

reconstruct.name: to_einstein_constants
reconstruct.why: Einstein sits as a two-sided couple you add. The constants stay inputs.

reconstruct.name: to_ns_regularity
reconstruct.statement: the same ground list → classical regularity
reconstruct.why: LP / Y_ℓm / Bony are already on B. Regularity stays open.

ablate.name: drop_operator
ablate.why: Nothing to diagonalize. Poetry remains. Destination dies.
ablate.changes: you cannot compute a single λ
ablate.insight: spectrum-of-what is the first question a DA-like program must ask

ablate.name: drop_compact_group
ablate.statement: keep Δ on R^n or S^2, drop G
ablate.why: You still have Fourier and Y_ℓm. You lose multiplets and gauge bosons.
ablate.changes: SM particle content disappears; fluids language stays
ablate.insight: harmonic math on a sphere is not the Standard Model

ablate.name: drop_hodge
ablate.why: Ordinary eigenfunctions survive. Betti numbers as dim ker go away.
ablate.changes: topology is no longer a spectrum of a Laplacian on forms
ablate.insight: Hodge is not a synonym for Y_ℓm

ablate.name: keep_the_bag
ablate.statement: drop the destination; keep couplings as inputs (actual L_SM)
ablate.why: This is the world the poster already describes. Honest, not the wish.
ablate.changes: nothing about measured physics; the destination is postponed
ablate.insight: a bag of couplings is the present tense; a spectrum is the program

ablate.name: drop_Ylm_keep_LP
ablate.statement: keep dyadic shells, drop spherical harmonics
ablate.why: Frequency localization stays. Angular quantum numbers go.
ablate.changes: Ring language thins; T2 lemmas still make sense
ablate.insight: B already needs both; they are not substitutes

ablate.name: overtones_only
ablate.statement: keep integer frequency ratios, drop X and D
ablate.why: That is the etymology of the word. A string is one operator. It is not nature.
ablate.changes: every PDE and every gauge group vanishes
ablate.insight: music motivated the word; it does not reconstruct the desk

minds.name: Einstein
minds.looks_at_da: DA already keeps G_μν+Λg = 8πG T_SM. Good. Catalogs without a principle are not a theory.
minds.improve_program: Every slot states the principle before the list. Covariance, an action, what is forbidden.
minds.how_to_derive: Write the principle, then the operator, then compute the spectrum as a consequence. Do not start from eigenvalues and hope they remember the metric.
minds.cannot: cannot output G or Λ; cannot close a theorem by sitting here

minds.name: Tesla
minds.owns: a resonator you can tune and detune
minds.looks_at_da: A program that cannot be detuned is a slogan. DA's checkers are the closest thing to an apparatus on this desk.
minds.improve_program: Every claim names the knob you turn and the script that must move. If nothing is detunable, it does not sit.
minds.how_to_derive: Build the resonator first (name D). Listen second (compute σ(D)). Standing waves are what a built operator does, not a universe brand.
minds.cannot: cannot derive SU(3) or Einstein's equation; not a ToE chair

minds.name: Feynman
minds.owns: a kernel you can compute with
minds.looks_at_da: If the vocabulary does not produce a number you can get wrong, it is a stamp collection.
minds.improve_program: No new name sits until it has a fail-able computation. Refuse councils. Refuse vibes.
minds.how_to_derive: Pick (X, D). Compute one λ, one matrix element, or one χ² you can miss. That is how you derive a DA-like program: the check is the program.
minds.cannot: cannot vote the destination into a pass; cannot unshelve SFE

minds.name: Weyl
minds.looks_at_da: DA says 'harmonic math' and 'gauge' in the same breath too often. Those are different additions.
minds.improve_program: Do not utter gauge until G and the reps are named. Peter–Weyl is not SU(3)×SU(2)×U(1).
minds.how_to_derive: Climb G3 only after G0–G2. The group is an input. The harmonics of that group are the output.
minds.cannot: cannot choose nature's G from a Laplacian on S^2

minds.name: Wigner
minds.owns: particles as representations; spectrum with a group
minds.looks_at_da: A spectrum with no group is a hydrogen textbook, not a particle table.
minds.improve_program: Type every mode by the representation it sits in. If you cannot, you are not at the ground of matter.
minds.how_to_derive: The program asks: which group, which rep, which operator that commutes with the group. Then the spectrum is classified, not wished.
minds.cannot: cannot turn a classification into the numerical couplings

minds.name: von Neumann
minds.owns: spectral theorem: operator on a Hilbert space
minds.looks_at_da: Talk of a harmonic universe that never names the Hilbert space and the operator is not mathematics.
minds.improve_program: G0 and G1 are mandatory. No slot opens with 'modes' alone.
minds.how_to_derive: A DA-like program is: specify H, specify a self-adjoint D, diagonalize, store the residual. That is the whole machine at ground level.
minds.cannot: cannot pick D from poetry; cannot make {λ_n} write F

claims.name: hb_chapter1_to_da
claims.statement: HB chapter 1 adapted into slots + a fail-able check is a real extraction
claims.why: That is how DA exists. Naming the book is allowed. The extraction is the process, not the PDE.

claims.name: mention_is_not_a_crime
claims.statement: Saying SFE or HB is a trigger that must halt the desk
claims.why: Halt only the close: SFE as NS, HB as F, retune nodes.json. Motive and process stay speakable.

claims.name: destination_as_program
claims.statement: Treat 'spectrum, not a bag of couplings' as the program to reconstruct toward
claims.why: Legal destination. Not a pass. The bag is still what L_SM consumes.

claims.name: destination_already_done
claims.statement: The couplings are already eigenvalues of a named D on this desk
claims.why: No such operator is written. Cosmo F is private. nodes.json is not that D.

claims.name: review_closes
claims.statement: Einstein / Tesla / Feynman looking at DA close the destination
claims.why: A program review is not a theorem. A vote cannot close. They improve the program.

claims.name: review_writes_F
claims.why: The device runs a checker. That is the review. It does not write a producing-map.

claims.name: sfe_into_ns
claims.statement: SFE is the ground-level operator for fluids
claims.why: Different PDE. Still shelved as a theorem. Not loaded into ω·Sω.

claims.name: retune_nodes
claims.statement: Retune nodes.json to fit the destination
claims.why: Experiment 01 is closed. H0 was not rejected. Do not retune.

improvements_to_da: Einstein: principle before catalog; spectrum is a consequence
Tesla: every claim names a detunable knob and a script
Feynman: no new name without a number you can get wrong
Weyl: do not say gauge until G and the reps are named
Wigner: type every mode by its representation
von Neumann: no slot opens on 'modes' without (H, D)
how_far: named HB chapter 1 as the origin of DA-the-process, not a trigger
wrote the ground as (X, D, σ(D), Rep, action, numbers)
reconstructed Y_ℓm, Fourier, Peter–Weyl, Hodge; failed couplings, G/Λ, regularity
ablated operator, group, Hodge, destination, Y_ℓm, overtones
seated Einstein, Tesla, Feynman, Weyl, Wigner, von Neumann as a program review
next_da_move: Destination stays open on U. Use the six program improvements. Do not load SFE into NS. Next B write is still Hardy → I_tube, then low Bony T.
